description:
My name is Mark Rhein. I am a Master Electrician and an electrical contractor (owner of Rhein Electrical) licensed to do business in California.  I am a jack of all trades guy with wide ranging interests. I have remodeled houses and have experience in most of the trades. I have built an 8000 square foot custom home on raw land and have many experiences that would likely help the average DIY guy. 

I am also a writer of speculative screenplays and interested in history and historical figures.  I was married for 40 years to the same woman and was recently divorced so now I am a single guy navigating the dating world. 

The purpose of this channel is to provide information that I think is worth your time hearing about. I will read all your comments. Thanks for watching!
